title: review.json
description: Describes a review. Written once when the review is created and never rewritten: everything that changes later is an event.

id.description: Also the folder name under reviews/. A ULID is recommended; readers accept any value matching the pattern.

title.description: The title at creation. A reviewRenamed event supersedes it.

createdBy.description: The device id that created the review.

baseRef.description: What the user chose as the base, for display and for retargeting.

mode.description: mergeBase: the diff starts at the merge-base of base and head (pull-request style). direct: it starts at the base tip.

pin.description: The commits at creation. A reviewRetargeted event supersedes it.

displayName.description: Usually the folder name of the repository.

originUrl.description: The origin URL when there is one.

rootCommit.description: The lexicographically smallest root commit reachable from the head. Null when unknown.

baseSha.description: The left side of the diff: the merge-base in mergeBase mode, else the base tip.

baseTipSha.description: What the base ref resolved to.

Sha.description: A full lowercase hexadecimal commit id.
